# Carly Gage Photography

> Flower Mound family photographer specializing in authentic, stress-free family sessions, plus newborn, maternity, baby announcement, and mini sessions. Based in Flower Mound, TX and serving families across the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex (roughly a 40-mile radius: Highland Village, Lewisville, Grapevine, Coppell, Southlake, Colleyville, Argyle, Lantana, Trophy Club, Frisco, Plano, and beyond).

## Core Content

- [Home](https://carlygage.com/): The main hub and the primary page for "Flower Mound family photographer" — services, portfolio galleries, and information about stress-free family photography sessions.
- [Services](https://carlygage.com/#services): Session types — Family, Newborn, Maternity, Baby Announcement, and Mini Sessions with details on duration, images included, and locations.
- [About](https://carlygage.com/#about): Meet Carly — patient, playful photographer who captures real family moments in Flower Mound and throughout DFW.
- [Portfolio](https://carlygage.com/#portfolios): Real families, real moments, real joy. Galleries showcasing authentic family photography.
- [Contact](https://carlygage.com/#contact): Inquiry form to book sessions or ask questions. Quick response within 24 hours. Phone: (214) 422-8050.
- [FAQ](https://carlygage.com/#faq): Common questions about session timing, locations, what to wear, and service areas.

## Session Types

**Family Sessions**: One hour at a beautiful location. Focus on play, laughter, and connection. 40 edited images included.

**Newborn & Baby Sessions**: Gentle, lifestyle-leaning sessions to capture your new arrival.

**Maternity Sessions**: Relaxed one-hour session celebrating pregnancy. Two outfit changes allowed. Partners always welcome.

**Baby Announcement**: One-hour creative session to capture excitement. Perfect for social media and keepsakes. 40 edited images.

**Mini Sessions**: Short, sweet, and simple. 20-minute session delivering 10 beautiful images. Perfect for milestones and busy families.

- **Base Location**: Flower Mound, Texas (service-area business — no walk-in studio address)
- **Service Area**: Flower Mound and the surrounding Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex (~40-mile radius)

- **Style**: Authentic, joyful, stress-free photography
- **Approach**: Patient, playful, capturing real moments
- **Response Time**: Within 24 hours for inquiries
